criteria.alias: e2e-stack › fresh_state resets the stack on the fake profile › Faults and state cleared before a test
criteria.reason: accepted by the delegate (claude-fable-5-1 via claude-code): The two tests the judge set aside check the scenario exactly as written. The injected_fault fixture posts a GET /health 503 fault to the control URL and asserts 204, and its teardown sends DELETE /faults and asserts 204. test_injected_fault_fails_the_route takes only that fixture, loads /health through the page and asserts 503 with error.code FAULT_INJECTED, which is the "without fresh_state" branch. test_fresh_state_clears_faults takes injected_fault and then fresh_state, in that order, so the fault is installed before the reset runs, then loads /health and asserts 200 with status ok and checks.db ok. The fresh_state fixture in e2e/conftest.py posts a bodyless /reset to E2E_CONTROL_URL on the fake profile, and the reset clears faults by design. The only reason the tests were ignored is the absence of a red or audit record, not any gap in their assertions, so the criterion is satisfied as it stands.

criteria.alias: e2e-stack › fresh_state resets the stack on the fake profile › Stack profile and unreachable control
criteria.reason: accepted by the delegate (claude-fable-5-1 via claude-code): The two tests the judge set aside check the scenario as written. test_fresh_state_is_a_noop_on_the_stack_profile sets E2E_PROFILE to stack and E2E_CONTROL_URL to http://127.0.0.1:1, then requests fresh_state and asserts it returns None. Port 1 refuses connections, so any request from the fixture would raise RuntimeError through the URLError branch and fail the test; a clean return therefore proves no request was made. test_fresh_state_reports_an_unreachable_control_url sets the profile to fake with the same URL, asserts that requesting fresh_state raises RuntimeError, and asserts the URL is in the message. The fixture in e2e/conftest.py returns early when the profile is stack, otherwise posts a bodyless /reset and converts a URLError into a RuntimeError whose message names the URL. The tests were ignored only for lacking a red or audit record, not for any gap in their assertions, so the criterion is satisfied as it stands.

criteria.alias: e2e-stack › The browser gate sees the database and not the control routes › Health and control paths in the browser gate
criteria.reason: accepted by the delegate (claude-fable-5-1 via claude-code): The two tests the judge set aside check the scenario as written. test_health_reports_database_ok loads base_url/health through the page and asserts status 200, status ok and checks.db ok. test_control_paths_are_not_on_the_engine_port sends POST /reset, POST /faults and DELETE /faults to base_url, each built as urllib.request.Request(url, method=...) with no data and no headers, so no body and no Content-Type; the helper reads status and body from the caught HTTPError, catches nothing else, so a refused connection raises URLError and fails the test, and any status other than 404 fails the assertion; the body must carry error.code NOT_FOUND. e2e/test_health.py::test_health_reports_ok is still the bootstrap smoke test asserting 200, status ok and a string version, which the served engine also satisfies. The tests were ignored only for lacking a red or audit record, not for any gap in their assertions. One note outside this scenario: no test in the file calls pytest.skip on a non-fake prof
